nodes.label: SmartStore project context memory
nodes.rationale: Summarizes the SmartStore product, stack, roles, modules, completed backend/frontend work, database setup, and next steps.

nodes.label: Role-based access control
nodes.rationale: The design defines OWNER, ADMIN, CASHIER, INVENTORY, and SUPERVISOR roles with different operational and approval permissions.

nodes.label: Transactional goods receipt posting
nodes.rationale: The implemented receiving flow validates PO status and quantities, registers IMEIs, creates stock-in movements, updates balances, and advances PO status.

nodes.label: Store, tax, and transaction numbering settings
nodes.rationale: Settings include store profile, timezone, IDR display, receipt footer/prefix, sequential numbering, tax mode/rate, return window, discount limit, and session timeout.

nodes.label: Searchable audit logs
nodes.rationale: The audit-log endpoint lists critical actions with actor, time, entity, metadata, filters, pagination, and safe user fields; writing is not yet wired into services.

nodes.label: Frontend admin and cashier pages
nodes.rationale: The completed frontend includes login, dashboard, POS, products, inventory, sales, returns, and reports routes with a protected sidebar layout.

nodes.label: Frontend API and JWT auth integration
nodes.rationale: The frontend uses a typed API client, /api/v1 prefix, response-envelope unwrapping, JWT localStorage, and an AuthContext for login/logout and protected navigation.

nodes.label: Frontend-backend runtime contract
nodes.rationale: The backend runs on port 3000 while the frontend runs on 3001 and calls NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL at the backend, with the API prefix /api/v1.

nodes.label: Database migrations and seed data
nodes.rationale: Four migrations create the core schema, and seeders establish roles, tax classes, app settings, and initial admin/owner accounts.

nodes.label: Verified backend implementation state
nodes.rationale: The project context records the backend scaffold as complete, with typecheck and build passing and the bcrypt vulnerability remediation completed.

nodes.label: Verified JWT authentication flow
nodes.rationale: The recorded verification covers login returning a JWT/user, guarded me and logout endpoints, role-protected users, and 401 error cases.
